description: LiveRamp ATS Envelope API on api.rlcdn.com/api/identity/v2/envelope. Cookie sync on idsync.rlcdn.com is not contracted. Envelope refresh is vendor/liveramp-envelope-refresh.

params.name: pid
params.description: It is the LiveRamp Placement ID.
params.fix_hint: Send `pid` with the Placement ID LiveRamp issued for this property.

params.name: it
params.description: It is the identifier type. LiveRamp documents `4` hashed email, `11` hashed phone, and `15` custom ID.
params.fix_hint: Send `it=4` for hashed email, `it=11` for hashed phone, or `it=15` for a custom ID.

params.name: iv
params.description: It is the hashed identifier, or `ANA_ID:CUSTOM_ID` when `it` is 15.
params.fix_hint: Send `iv` with the hashed email, hashed phone, or `accountId:customId`.

params.name: ct
params.description: It is the consent type. LiveRamp documents `4` TCF v2 and `3` CCPA. GPP traffic can use `gpp` and `gpp_sid` instead.
params.fix_hint: Send `ct=4` with a TCF string in `cv`, or `ct=3` for CCPA.

params.name: atype
params.description: It is the implementation source. LiveRamp documents `1` ATS.js, `2` ATS API, `3` server-to-server, and `4` the deprecated mobile SDK.
params.fix_hint: Send `atype=2` from an API call, or `atype=3` from a server.
